answer_2.quote: We compare the HTM strategies using representative topic quality metrics in the literature . We consider three classes of topic quality metrics based on three criteria: (a) coherence, (b) mutual information, and (c) semantic representation... Regarding the metrics, coherence ... We employ an improved version of regular coherence ... called Coherence ... Another class ... NPMI ... Finally, ... the average distance ... We here also employ the cosine distance, defined as d cos (x, y) = 1 -x T y.
